bootstrap.interval: 95% exploratory conditional on fixed checkpoints; no selection/multiplicity/training-seed correction

retention.quality_candidate: positive macroAUC point difference versus corresponding original with all tasks/costs reported
retention.scope: Queue policy, not statistical equivalence or automatic model promotion

conditional_best_single_comparisons.selection: For each parent, highest macroAUC successful candidate (tie fixed experiment order), only if point macroAUC exceeds best single; at most2 pairs.
conditional_best_single_comparisons.bootstrap: same accepted500user draws/seed20260906; selection-conditional exploratory intervals, not multiplicity or training-seed guarantee.

repair_policy: No optimizer/Q initialization/dense clipping or LR repair. Failed candidate stops and preserves artifacts; no automatic restart. No extra training seed.
hypothesis: Task-specific conditions may improve second history retrieval beyond a common round-specific bias while retaining the full original per-task slots and no prediction-to-work feedback.

formula.native_prefix: e=L0(q,H); z1=L1(e,H); y1=L2(e,z1); x=(e+z1)/2 use original arithmetic and weights once.
formula.retrieval_only: For each task t, second work original w_q projection u receives u + condition.to(u.dtype) before original head reshape/q_norm. Original w_qi(x), outer residual x, H/K/V/mask remain.

modes.shared: condition=b.mean(dim=0); all four original B/S branches actually execute.
modes.task: condition=b[t]; all four original B/S branches actually execute.

formula.initialization: One zero-initialized bias [4,384], appended after original parameter traversal before optimizer construction, without extra constructor RNG. Initial per-task forward equivalence requires actual checks; it is not assumed from zero initialization.
formula.prediction: For each t: y2_t=L2(y1,z2_t), then original post attention/norm/FFN and matching original task tower. Full S slots per task. No prediction state is used for work queries.
formula.gradient_scope: No detach. Four branch gradient accumulation and added bias change clip/PSGDKron layout/state/dynamics. Shared mode has fewer effective condition dimensions despite equal registered parameter count. Do not repair or claim native optimizer matching.
formula.controls: Only shared/task training modes; no zero-bias fast path. Scoped routing must clean up on normal/error exits. No model torch.compile or gradient checkpointing.
formula.cost: 1536 new parameters; second work/prediction/post run four branches. Original first read/entry/shared first prediction and four task towers are retained. Measure actual full-batch VRAM, training and seven-model forward costs.

selection_boundary: Task versus shared bias tests task-specific retrieval conditioning within separately trained full-branch models; same registered shape is not equal effective freedom or optimizer dynamics. It does not alone prove better use of z1, causal information quantity, task exclusivity, or gain over original. All tasks and direct contrasts retained; macro remains primary.
execution_prerequisite: Complete prior R result reviews/interpretation/memory closeout before N GPU execution; finish new CPU/source reviews, then bounded native CUDA stage gate and four actual2step smokes before formal training. No extra seed or budget changes.
